div.p: Find quick answers to common questions about our development process, timelines, and services.

div.div: SynFusion specializes in native & cross-platform Android app development, custom website development, complex web applications, UI/UX design systems, enterprise software tools, and AI feature integrations.

div.span: How does the development process work?

div.div: We follow a structured 5-step methodology: Discover (goal analysis), Plan (scope & architecture), Design (UI/UX prototypes), Develop (agile coding & QA), and Launch (deployment & support).

div.span: How long does a typical project take?

div.div: Timelines vary depending on project complexity. Standard responsive websites usually take 2 to 4 weeks, while full-scale Android or web applications can take 6 to 12 weeks. We establish concrete milestones during discovery.
Pricing is based on overall technical complexity, total feature set, UI/UX design requirements, and API integrations. We provide transparent, custom quotes after reviewing your requirements.

div.span: Can you improve or redesign an existing application?

div.div: Yes! We perform full UI/UX redesigns, performance audits, code refactoring, and feature additions for pre-existing Web and Android applications.

div.span: Do you offer post-launch maintenance and support?

div.div: Yes. We offer continuous post-launch maintenance, security audits, server monitoring, and feature updates to ensure long-term stability.
